heading.title: Install your first plugin
heading.note: Choose how to run the CLI, select one or more agents, and copy the command.

brew.title: Homebrew
brew.description: Native Go CLI for macOS and Linux. Node.js is not required.
brew.note: Recommended for a permanent install with automatic Homebrew upgrades.

npm.title: npx · Node.js 22+
npm.description: Fastest when Node.js 22+ is already installed: run the plugin command immediately.
npm.note: Zero-install: npx downloads the verified CLI and runs the plugin command in one step.

script.title: Verified install script
script.description: Native install without a package manager. Node.js is not required.
script.note: Downloads the correct release binary and verifies its SHA-256 and version.

powershell.title: Windows PowerShell
powershell.description: Native Go CLI for Windows. Node.js is not required.
powershell.note: Downloads the Windows binary and verifies its SHA-256 and version.

install-cli.title: Run the CLI
install-cli.note: Use npx for a quick start, or install the binary for daily use.

try-plugin.title: Install a real plugin
try-plugin.note: The same command accepts one target or a comma-separated list.

build-plugin.title: Keep it current
build-plugin.note: Use update for a new release and repair when a client drifts.

validate.title: Remove cleanly
validate.note: The CLI removes managed client entries while retaining package data by default.
